title: The private key file is too open
fault: The arm sets the mode of the scratch private key to 0644.
prompts: What does the client say about your key file before it connects?
Who can read a private key in a safe setup?
hints: Read the warning. It names the mode and the path of the key.
The client refuses to use a key that others can read.

reveal.wrong: The arm set the mode of the practice private key to 0644, and the client refuses to use it.
reveal.fix: Set the key mode back to 0600, and keep key files readable only by their owner.
